title: Petrodollar Cracks While Bitcoin Coils
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

Five months of red candles. Petrodollar cracking. Bitcoin coiled at $70K.

**The story:** A parallel channel connecting COVID lows through the 2021 high just pinned every major inflection point across two cycles. That's geometry, not hopium. If resistance holds, $85K is the ceiling—not a moonshot.
